title: R1 · 图书馆安静时段
english: A quiet hour at the library

cues.text: A university library recently tested a quiet hour near the end of each afternoon.
Students could still enter and borrow books, but phone calls and group conversations had to move to another floor.
The aim was to help students finish work that required concentration, without closing the library to people who needed to collaborate.
During the trial, some students said they finished reading assignments faster because there were fewer interruptions.
Others found the rule inconvenient, especially when they arrived shortly before a group meeting and had nowhere nearby to talk.
The librarians therefore opened an unused room for discussion and put directions at the main entrance.
Their early survey suggested that the quiet hour worked best when students knew where to go before it began.
The library plans to keep the trial for another month and collect feedback at different times of day.
The organisers say they will keep the rule only if students can still find a suitable place for both kinds of work.

title: R2 · 校园食堂预约取餐
english: A pickup system at the campus café

cues.text: A campus café recently tested a pickup system during its busiest lunch hour.
Students could still order at the counter, but anyone who ordered in advance had to collect food from a separate shelf.
The aim was to shorten the line for people with limited time, without making the café harder to use for other customers.
During the trial, some students said they returned to class sooner because they spent less time waiting.
Others found the system confusing, especially when several bags looked alike and nobody was nearby to answer questions.
The café therefore labelled each order with a number and put directions beside the entrance.
An early survey suggested that the system worked best when customers knew their order number before they reached the shelf.
The manager plans to keep the trial for another month and collect feedback on different days of the week.
The café will keep the system only if both ordering options remain easy to use when it is busy.
